description:
[Wicked Registry] Step 2 of getting a free API key. Submit the wallet, the timestamp and YOUR signature over the message from registry_onboarding_message(action=api_key). The key (wr_...) is returned once - store it and pass it as api_key to registry_search_tools / registry_tool_detail. Up to 3 active keys per wallet; past the daily cap calls fall back to x402.

Use when you signed the onboarding message and want a free Registry API key (shown once). Not for inspecting a key (use registry_key_info).

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

timestamp.description: The timestamp returned with the message.

name: registry_create_api_key
